name: application-rating-distribution
title: Rating Distribution
description: Aggregate star-rating breakdown components showing the count or percentage of reviews at each star level alongside an overall average.
useWhen: Aggregate star-rating breakdown components showing the count or percentage of reviews at each star level alongside an overall average.
avoidWhen: Avoid rating distribution when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Rating Distribution uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
